notes.title: WE'RE BACK!!
notes.notes:
It has taken a while but we're finally back on the Steam Store!

In 2013, Blitz Games Studios sadly closed their doors and because they were the publisher of Fluttabyes on Steam, the game disappeared from the store.

We're not quite sure why it took this long for us to get back but perhaps we can just use the phrase: "The best things come to those who wait" - which immediately makes me think of Joey from Friends waiting for ketchup...

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N_vssdys8lk

It's good to be back!

notes.title: Fluttabyes Update Released
notes.notes:
Updates to Fluttabyes have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:
  • Blitz mode has you rushing to earn back time and trying to keep the game going for as long as possible! Complete with Steam integrated online high score tables, so you can compete against friends and family.
  • The update also includes a new Festive location, the winter cabin theme. A forest location with Christmas lights and snow covered branches.
  • Finally the update contains welcome bug fix for windows 7 users. Where the game was previously staying active in the system tray, it now closes completely ;P

notes.title: Three New Games From Blitz 1UP Released, 20% Off
notes.notes:
Blitz 1UP games Mole Control, KrissX, and Fluttabyes are released. All three games are 20% off until April 27th.

Mole Control is an addictive puzzle game that brings the classic logic-based game play of minesweeper into the 21st century.

KrissX is a captivating and relaxing mix of puzzle game and word game. Swap letters and decipher clues to solve a series of clever puzzles.

Fluttabyes is a fun, quirky take on a Match 3 game. Easy to pick up and play, yet deeply addictive, the aim of Fluttabyes is to help the butterflies fly away by matching four or more of the same color.
